name: Browse catalogue and add a bike to the basket
covers: product catalogue search and category filters
description: Verifies the customer can find a bike, open its detail page, add it to the basket and see the updated basket.
steps: Open Shop from the storefront navigation
Open a product card and add the bike to the basket
Open the basket and increase the quantity
expected: The selected product appears in the basket with the updated quantity and recalculated subtotal.

name: Complete a demo checkout and view the order in admin
description: Verifies the checkout blocks missing information and stores a clearly labelled local demo order visible in the admin workspace.
steps: Add a product to the basket and proceed to checkout
Attempt to continue with required customer fields empty
Complete the customer and delivery details, choose a payment option and place the demo order
Open Admin preview and select Orders
expected: Required fields are validated; after completion, a demo order appears in the admin order list and no real payment is claimed.

name: Create and edit a catalogue item in admin on mobile
description: Verifies the mobile admin workspace supports adding, editing and deleting a locally stored prototype product.
steps: Open Admin preview and select Products
Add a product with a name, manufacturer and valid price
Edit the new product and save it
Refresh the page and verify the edited product remains
expected: The edited product persists after refresh and is removed after the delete action.

name: Submit a demo crypto payment reference without claiming verification
description: Verifies the crypto flow requires a demo reference and never represents it as a verified blockchain payment.
steps: Add a product and complete checkout using Cryptocurrency
Enter the required customer and delivery details
Place the demo order and attempt to submit an empty transaction reference
Enter a sample reference and submit it
Open Admin preview and select Crypto review
expected: The empty reference is rejected; a sample reference is labelled evidence submitted in demo state, with a clear notice that no blockchain payment was verified.
